mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalPurchase, SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'SALE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalSale, SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalExpense, SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'SALE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS netProfit FROM tb_ledger WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND trx_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM trx_date)::int AS dow, ROUND(AVG(daily_total)) AS avgSale FROM ( SELECT trx_date, SUM(amount) AS daily_total FROM tb_ledger WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND trx_type = 'SALE' AND trx_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 weeks' GROUP BY trx_date ) daily GROUP BY dow ORDER BY avgSale DESC

SELECT trx_date AS trxDate, LAG(trx_date) OVER (ORDER BY trx_date) AS prevDate, trx_date - LAG(trx_date) OVER (ORDER BY trx_date) AS gapDays FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT trx_date FROM tb_ledger WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND trx_type = 'PURCHASE' ORDER BY trx_date ) purchases ORDER BY trxDate DESC LIMIT 10
